bundle.shortDescription: Track AI usage across multiple providers
bundle.longDescription: AI Usage Tracker is a standalone Windows and macOS desktop app for monitoring OpenAI Codex, Anthropic Claude, Google Antigravity, Google AI Studio, Grok / SuperGrok, and OpenCode Go usage, with an optional sanitized Paseo integration over localhost.
